scope: PC-only look layer for the crosshaven_15 combat board (L9 outdoor). Does NOT replace shared tiles/ or the map tags json; a PC loader reads this folder.

files.looks: looks.json (per-cell look + prop placement for crosshaven_15)

anchors.prop: bottom-centre on the anchor cell south tip

lighting.shadows: contact AO only (fringe/foot AO decals, baked soft prop ellipses alpha<=0.3); no baked long/cast shadows
lighting.grade: neutral warm daylight, NOT pre-graded (Mauro grades later)
